_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Damage Control Books and Diagrams for U.S. Navy Surface Ships
summary: Provides ships crews with information on the built-in damage control capabilities of shipboard systems, such as firefighting, communication, compressed air, fuel, and ventilation.
description_purpose: Damage Control Books and Diagrams provide ships crews with information on the built-in damage control capabilities of shipboard systems, such as Firefighting, Communication, Compressed Air, Fuel, Ventilation, etc.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to all contracts involving the development or revision of Damage Control Books and Diagrams for U.S. Navy surface ships.

This DID supersedes DI-TMSS-80514, DI-TMSS-80515, and DI-TMSS-80516.

Copies of Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) Technical Specification (NTS) 9090-820, entitled Preparation and Revision of Damage Control Books and Diagrams for U.S. Navy Surface Ships, can be obtained from the Damage Control and Firefighting Subgroup of the Naval Sea Systems Command, Department of the Navy, 2531 Jefferson Davis Highway, Arlington, VA 22242-5160.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the NAVSEA Technical Specification (NTS) 9090-820 cited herein, including its approval date and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content
preparation_instructions.content: The format and content of the surface ship Damage Control Books and Diagrams shall be in accordance with the requirements of NAVSEA Technical Specification (NTS) 9090-820 entitled: Preparation and Revision of Damage Control Books and Diagrams for U.S. Navy Surface Ships.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements
preparation_instructions.content: The damage control books and diagrams media requirements shall be as specified in the contract.
